[tab][ch]Bb[/ch]           [ch]A[/ch]     [ch]Dm[/ch]
    To see my baby there[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]Dm[/ch]         [ch]A7[/ch]         [ch]Dm[/ch]

[tab]   [ch]Bb[/ch]        [ch]A[/ch]        [ch]Dm[/ch]

[Verse 2]
[tab]        [ch]Dm[/ch]          [ch]A7[/ch]            [ch]Dm[/ch]

[tab][ch]Bb[/ch]          [ch]A[/ch]       [ch]Dm[/ch]

[tab]        [ch]Dm[/ch]               [ch]A7[/ch]         [ch]Dm[/ch]

[tab][ch]Bb[/ch]                        [ch]A[/ch]         [ch]Dm[/ch]
    And never find another man like me[/tab]

[Verse 3]
[tab]        [ch]Dm[/ch]              [ch]A7[/ch]        [ch]Dm[/ch]
When I die you can bury me in any tap shoes[/tab]
[tab][ch]Bb[/ch]         [ch]A[/ch]                    [ch]Dm[/ch]
   Set back with a twenty dollar hat;[/tab]
[tab]      [ch]Dm[/ch]                 [ch]A7[/ch]          [ch]Dm[/ch]
Put a twenty-dollar gold piece in my pocket[/tab]
[tab][ch]Bb[/ch]                             [ch]A[/ch]             [ch]Dm[/ch]
    And let the fellas know I died, standin' pat[/tab]
